name: Nonohara Mikako
source:
Another servant at Mamiya Manor, she's a married women who lives in the mansion with her son. She's been at the mansion longer than any previous servants, and is a good friend to the Mamiyas. [spoiler]In truth, she and her son are slaves to the Mamiyas due to their family's restaurant debt. Once the deadline pasts, the two will be sold through Marie's auction event.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/starless.html]JAST USA[/url]]
